appearancetable.name: C&O 1943 Color Light (1 head, automatic/intermediate)
appearancetable.reference: Single-lamp-head, three-color (R/Y/G) mast. Intended for plain intermediate/automatic block signals in open ABS territory with no diverging route at that location - this covers most of the Louisa-Gordonsville-Charlottesville-Staunton-Afton main line. "Stop" and "Stop and Proceed" both display red; on the prototype these were distinguished by a number plate on the mast (Stop and Proceed = permissive automatic signal), not by a different aspect. Give the mast the appropriate specific-appearance mapping below depending on whether it represents an automatic or an absolute (interlocking) signal.

appearance.reference: Automatic (intermediate) block signal only - number-plated on the prototype. Use this aspect, not "Stop", for masts that are NOT at an interlocking.
Absolute/interlocking signal - no number plate on the prototype. Use this aspect, not "Stop and Proceed", for masts that ARE at an interlocking or station home signal.
